name: Build fingerprint and kernel version
plain: Reads the full build ID string and kernel version.
meaning: Pins the exact firmware (model, build, patch) and so the OEM and carrier variant. Tight fingerprint; also tells where a phone was sold.

android.api_surface: Build.FINGERPRINT, ID, DISPLAY, TAGS, TYPE; System.getProperty(os.version)

ios.api_surface: Build and Darwin version; no carrier variant

limits.headline: Can see your exact phone software build, a long label often over 100 characters
limits.user_action: Nothing. The app can look it up as soon as it opens
can: See the full Android build label, with tags and type
See the kernel version on Android and iPhone
Use the label as one clue to tell similar phones apart
cannot: Learn who you are from this label alone
See a carrier version on iPhone; Apple gives a plain build and kernel version
Change the build or install a different one
limits.differs: Android shows a long detailed label. iPhone shows less and only a partial guess in some cases.

story.what_it_is: An app can read the exact firmware and system build of your phone.
story.for_you: You never see it. It is a long label with your phone's maker, build and patch. It tells an app what exact software you have and often where the phone was sold.
story.for_makers: Makers use it for bug fixes on one firmware version and for fraud checks. Because the label is so exact, it is also a strong fingerprint detail for tracking.

use_cases.example: A game applies a graphics workaround for a bug on one phone maker's build.
A bank notices a login from a build string that does not match a real phone.
A crash tool groups crashes by firmware so engineers find the bad update.
An ad firm adds the build label to a device fingerprint.
A streaming app checks that a build supports a video codec before offering 4K.
A fraud team spots a fake phone because its build label does not exist.

story.android_note: Available as Build.FINGERPRINT with no prompt.
story.ios_note: iOS shows a coarser build number and kernel version through system calls.

technical_bounds: Rooted or custom ROMs often show test-keys in TAGS
